method: The whole suite (2987 tests, OK) under an audit hook that credited every open() of a Markdown file inside the checkout to the test module running at the time (import, setUpClass or test), on White_Legion with Python 3.15 and JDK 25 (ROADMAP-3 96.5 C3). The tests that start a child process were read by hand: they run git or javac on temporary folders or are mocked, and read no repository document. A push to main runs everything, so a module missing here still fails there.
